metadata.description: PR review drop-ins that sit next to the review-kit reusable workflow.

plugins.name: ac-check
plugins.description: Check a PR against its Linear issue's acceptance criteria and post one report comment with file:line evidence; report only (ENG2-1656).

plugins.name: review-retro
plugins.description: Mine past PR review threads into a per-repo knowledge base and open a PR proposing cited REVIEW.md changes (ENG2-1655).

plugins.name: pr-channel
plugins.description: Channels server that streams GitHub PR review events into a running Claude Code session: signed webhooks, per-PR subscriptions, one session answers each event (ENG2-1657).
